page.title: Car auctions in France – Auction France
page.description: For every lot of the car auctions we cover: the French roadworthiness test (CT), known engine risks and the estimated total cost, before you bid.

engine.stellantis_puretech_eb2_turbo.ban: The 1.2 PureTech turbo has a “wet” timing belt that breaks down, and it sometimes burns oil.
engine.stellantis_puretech_eb2_turbo.che: Ask for an invoice for the belt's replacement and check whether the warranty covers the timing drive.

engine.stellantis_bluehdi_15_dv5.check: Ask for an invoice for the camshaft chain's inspection or replacement, and check whether the maker's cover applies to this car.
engine.renault_tce_12_h5ft.name: 1.2 TCe (H5Ft)

engine.renault_tce_12_h5ft.check: Ask for the service history and any invoice related to excessive oil consumption.

foot.label: Site pages
foot.indep: Auction France is a free, independent second opinion, not affiliated with Alcopa. Listings are in French on the auction house's site, with their photos and sale terms. Automatic analysis: it may contain errors, check on site before you bid.
foot.fees: Estimated cost = starting price + buyer's premium ({pct}% incl. VAT, at least {min} in the room) + VAT when a private buyer cannot recover it + repairs required by the CT (flat estimate) + CT to redo if needed. Not included: fixed per-lot fees, transport, registration. The final price depends on the bidding.
foot.fees_online: Estimated cost = displayed price (buyer's premium already included online) + VAT when a private buyer cannot recover it + repairs required by the CT (flat estimate) + CT to redo if needed. Not included: fixed per-lot fees, transport, registration. The final price depends on the bidding.
foot.fees_generic: Estimated cost = price + buyer's premium + VAT when a private buyer cannot recover it + repairs required by the CT (flat estimate) + CT to redo if needed. Not included: fixed per-lot fees, transport, registration. The final price depends on the bidding.
